payload.text: Look, 12 P. My grandchildren would pay more! Eh, eh. Be nice to your abuela. El Chato, the next stall, opens for everyone at half past nine tonight. He likes people who trade straight.
Oh, oh... 5 P, and only because you have a kind face.
Señor, my terms were spoken: one hundred thirteen. I do not take more than I asked, nor less. The card is yours at that figure.

Paco: Fifty-one! Nando, did you hear that? — Nando: I heard, hermano, my heart hurt. Look, amigo, we drove all night for this card, the last clean copy in three towns. Sixty-three primas and it's yours, wrapped, no questions. Cash now, we're gone before the lights come on. ¿Sí?
Patience is not a discount, señor. The term stands: 761 P. El Gato waits in the vault; he has waited longer than either of us.

¡Sesenta y dos! Nando, grab it, wrap it — done, amigo, hecho! You drive like a mule-thief, but we like you. Here, take it warm, still smells of ink. Noche de Movida, yours. Tell nobody what you paid, eh? Paco weeps, Nando laughs. ¡Adiós, hombre, we ride at dawn!

¡Eh, amigo, buenas! Paco y Nando, a tu servicio. ¿Treinta? Guarda eso, escucha —

— escucha esto: La Vía Láctea, impecable, brillo de estrella, y te la dejamos en diez. ¡Diez! Mi hermano llora cada vez que lo digo.

Mira el foil. Mira. ¿Trato hecho?
Nando, he's robbing us! Fine, 11 P. The team next door wants it, but we like you better.
Respect does not move terms, señor. Let it be 760 P — one peseta, to mark the courtesy. El Gato stays in the vault until you meet it.

Ay, hijo, you are too generous with me! Seven, five — my old head gets dizzy. Five P, that is my price, and I am happy with it. El Frutero goes home with you, and you go eat something, sí? Promise Abuela.

Paco: Fifty-seven. — Nando: Fifty-seven, hermano, and that's the last word from these lips. Our van is running, amigo, we leave in one minute, puff, gone. Say sí and the card is in your hands. Say no and we drive, no hard feelings, but no second chance. ¿Qué dices?
Deal! El Frutero de Argumosa for 5 P. Enjoy it, cariño.
Books and lists are other men's opinions, señor. Mine is this desk. 756 P for El Gato. Move four pesetas at a time if you wish; I do not tire.

¡Veintiséis! Paco, sujétame que me caigo. Amigo, doce. Doce peniques y la Vía Láctea se va contigo ahora mismo.

El equipo de al lado la quiere, ya han preguntado dos veces — pero tú nos caes mejor, qué le vamos a hacer. ¿Doce? Dilo y es tuya.
Nando, he's robbing us! Fine, 12 P. Last offer, amigo! Then we are gone, eh?

¡Hola, cariño! Come, sit a moment. Have you eaten? Look, this one, El Titiritero — a beautiful card, my favourite face on the whole table. For you, five P. Many little ones started their album with him, you know.
Firsts do not lower terms, señor; they raise them. 751 P for El Gato. The vault is cool and he is comfortable there. Decide when you wish.
Welcome, hijo! Look, La Castañera, 12 P. Made for beginners. El Chato, the next stall, opens for everyone at half past nine tonight. He likes people who trade straight.

¡Amigo, amigo, come closer! Paco, show him — sí, San Francisco el Grande, beautiful, no?

Nando: Look at that gold leaf. Collectors weep.

Paco: One hundred eighty-seven pesetas, for you only.

Nando: And listen — this is the last one in all Madrid, I swear on our mother.
Look, 5 P. My grandchildren would pay more!
Venga, 11 P. You drive a hard bargain for someone so young!

Buenas tardes, encantada. Sé exactamente qué tengo en mis álbumes, y qué vale cada cosa. Por La Vía Láctea le ofrezco dieciséis P. Una cifra honesta, se lo aseguro.

¡Ah, a man with money in his hand — Nando, I love this one already!

Nando: But one hundred? Our mother would weep harder than the collectors.

Paco: One hundred sixty-seven, amigo. Last in Madrid, remember. Say sí and the handshake is yours before the gold fades.

¡Un regular! Paco, did you hear — he comes back, he brings friends, he brings cousins!

Paco: For a man like that, one hundred fifty-five. Done, finished, I won't say it twice.

Nando: He always says it twice. But this time — mira, the gold is waiting. Shake, amigo.

Ay, hola cariño! Come, sit a little, you look hungry — have you eaten? Look here, this one is my pretty one, Mercado de la Paz. Twenty-nine pesetillas, and she is yours. She finishes a page very nicely, you will see.

Ay, hijo, you are too kind to me — but I will not take more than five P from you. Five, and that is that. Put him in your album tonight, and come back Sunday to tell me how he looks. Did you eat something today?

Deal! El Titiritero for 5 P. Enjoy it, cariño.
You learned, señor. That pleases me more than the sale. But lessons are free; El Gato is not. 746 P. He waits; so do I.
Veintinueve primas, no. Conozco su tirada tan bien como la mía, y el estado no cambia los números. Mi oferta sigue en pie: dieciséis P por La Vía Láctea. Honesta y firme, caballero.
Welcome, hijo! Look, Té Moruno, 12 P. Made for beginners. El Chato, the next stall, opens for everyone at half past nine tonight. He likes people who trade straight.

¡Finest in Madrid — Nando, write that on the suitcase!

Nando: In gold leaf, like the dome.

Paco: But one hundred twelve, amigo, our mother sleeps on straw already. One hundred forty-five. That's the regular's price, the cousin's price, the friend's price.

Nando: Shake now, before Paco remembers what it cost us.
Oh, oh... 12 P, and only because you have a kind face.
A page well finished, señor. El Gato would sit well over it. 741 P. Come back as often as you like; the roof is not going anywhere.
Las Vistillas. 13 P. Take it or leave it.

Veintiocho sigue siendo fantasía, caballero. Pero aprecio su insistencia elegante: subo a diecisiete P por La Vía Láctea. Un gesto, no una costumbre. Decídase, que mis álbumes esperan desde los años sesenta.
Future business is welcome, señor — bring your epics. But this is my last word: 736 P for El Gato. Refuse, and I close the matter and keep him.

Veintisiete, imposible. Pero no quiero despedirle con las manos vacías: dieciocho P por La Vía Láctea. Es mi gesto final de cortesía, caballero. Piénselo bien; el álbum lleva décadas esperando ese hueco.
13. Same as before. I don't move first.
Señor, I know every copy of that card by name. Impeccable or not, my figure stands: 22 P. It is a good figure, and I do not play games. Shall we close it, or no?

Ay, hola cariño! Come, sit a moment, the table does not bite. Have you eaten today? Look, this one — Café en Goya, very pretty card, my favourite little picture. For you, twelve P. A good one to start a page with, hijo.
Bonita historia, y casi exacta. Guárdela para otro domingo. Hoy mis términos no cambian: El Gato de Lavapiés, setecientos sesenta y uno. La chulapa sigue en su sitio.

Un gesto, dice. Veintiséis sigue muy lejos, caballero. Aun así, correspondo: diecinueve P por La Vía Láctea. Bajar yo, subir usted; así se cierran los tratos elegantes. Mi álbum espera, pero no eternamente.

Ay, hola cariño! Come, sit a moment. Have you eaten? Look, this one — Café de Madrugada, very pretty card, my favourite little picture. For you, five P. My grandson started his album with this one, forty years ago, same table.
